inputs.human: What should a staff member do after accidentally sending patient information to the wrong recipient?

outputs.reference_output: Report the suspected misdirected message immediately through the approved incident process, preserve relevant information, and do not conceal or independently resolve the incident. [SEC_004]

inputs.human: What should a user do about a stolen hospital device and a suspected malware incident?

outputs.reference_output: Report the stolen device promptly. [SEC_024] Report suspected malware immediately through the approved channel, preserve relevant information, and do not investigate beyond your authority. [SEC_027]

inputs.human: How should managers handle unsafe staffing and overtime changes, and what is the maximum overtime shift length?

outputs.reference_output: Escalate staffing gaps and unsafe workloads through the approved coverage process, and keep any temporary reassignment within verified competence or authorization. [SEC_011] Managers approve overtime changes in accordance with workforce, budget, and fatigue-management requirements. [SEC_012] The policies do not state a maximum overtime shift length.

inputs.human: How may patients ask to see their medical records?

inputs.human: What happens when a patient raises a formal grievance, and how is feedback used to improve care?

outputs.reference_output: Formal grievances follow the approved process; complaints are documented, reviewed, and answered by the responsible team. [SEC_009] Leaders review feedback trends to identify improvements, assign accountable owners, and document follow-up and outcomes. [SEC_010]

inputs.human: What number should I call to ask about a hospital service that is not in the policies?

outputs.reference_output: Call the hospital general line at 555-0100.

inputs.human: Who should receive a report about cleaning conditions that may affect patients or visitors?

outputs.reference_output: Environmental Services or the responsible manager. [SEC_014]

inputs.human: When can records be securely destroyed, and what exact retention period applies to each category?

outputs.reference_output: Records may be securely destroyed through authorized processes when the approved retention period ends, provided no legal hold, investigation, or audit is suspending disposal. [SEC_026] Exact retention periods for each category are not specified.
